headline: Approved appointment of Pat Long as K-8 STEM Coordinator for the 2026-2027 school year, contingent on Connecticut certification.
summary: The meeting went into executive session to interview candidates for K-8 STEM Coordinator. After returning to open session, the appointment of Pat Long to the position was approved, contingent on proper Connecticut certification.
decisions: Approved the appointment of Pat Long as K-8 STEM Coordinator in the Curriculum Department for the 2026-2027 school year, contingent on proper Connecticut certification, by a unanimous vote.

decision_evidence.quote: VOTE: Unanimous Approval that the Board of Education approve the appointment of the following candidate to an administrative position for the 2026-2027 school year, contingent upon proper Connecticut certification, as recommended by the Superintendent of Schools: Curriculum Department K-8 STEM Coordinator Pat Long Motion Passed
